test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Federalism is one of the key features of the Constitution of India, under which:

options.text: The head of the government is also head of the state
states draw their authority from the Parliament
all persons in India are governed by laws and policies made by the Judiciary only
states are agents of the Federal government

solution:
The correct answer is __**states are agents of the Federal government.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

__
 
• **Federalism** is part of the basic structure of the Indian constitution which cannot be altered or destroyed through constitutional amendments under the constituent powers of the Parliament without undergoing judicial review by the Supreme Court.
 
• Federal features of the Indian constitution:
 
 
• Written constitution.
 
• Supremacy of constitution.
 
• Division of powers.
 
• Independent judiciary.
 
• Bicameralism.
 
• Rigidity of constitution.
 
• **Two governments. **
 
 
 
• **Hence **states are agents of the Federal government is most appropriate answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Unitary features of the Indian constitution:

 
 
• Integrated judiciary.
 
• Single constitution.
 
• Strong centre.
 
• Single citizenship.
 
• All India services.
